LightningComponentBundle.description: Generate QR Codes with optional logo overlay.

property.name: value
property.label: Value
property.description: The text of the code. The code is generated without a click.

property.name: size
property.label: Size
property.description: The displayed size of the code in pixels.

property.name: colorDark
property.label: Dark Color
property.description: The color of the dark modules of the code.

property.name: colorLight
property.label: Light Color
property.description: The color of the light modules of the code.

property.name: logoUrl
property.label: Logo URL
property.description: The logo to show in the code. An image from another domain needs to allow this with CORS.

property.name: hideInput
property.label: Hide Input
property.description: Only show the code, without the inputs and the generate button.
